commits.title: Enhance Christmas login theme and implement Azure telemetry
commits.before_text: Christmas login lighting used the earlier effect implementation, and the application lacked the new opt-in server telemetry integration.
commits.after_text: Refines Christmas login lighting, snow and interaction styling. Adds opt-in server telemetry to WSGI/ASGI startup with settings, dependency updates, deployment guidance and dedicated regression tests.

comparisons.title: Seasonal sign-in — desktop
comparisons.before_text: The previous rendered sign-in screen with the seasonal theme selected.
comparisons.after_text: The updated sign-in screen with the same theme selected. This static view does not show animation.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged ui capture, recipe login-layout. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; external traffic blocked. Only the historical decoration script rendered a reduced-motion frame.
